_theme_note: Sourced from the Delhi Traffic Police's own itemized waterlogging list (DDA Appendix III), not the 2025/2026 news-reported '445 hotspots' figure (that fuller list isn't public). The source list covers all of NCT Delhi (~162 entries); shown here are the subset whose named landmark/road could be geocoded to a real OSM feature within the New Delhi PC boundary via an Overpass poly-filtered search -- about half the ~106 distinct location names in-PC matched; the rest either lack an OSM feature with a close-enough name, or are genuinely outside this PC (the poly filter would have excluded them either way).
